steps.label: Bronze is now incremental
steps.sub: only new source files land each run

steps.label: A full Silver rebuild is wasteful
steps.sub: most rows haven't changed since yesterday

steps.label: The fix: MERGE INTO
steps.sub: update what changed, insert what's new

code:
MERGE INTO silver.sales_clean AS target
USING bronze_incremental AS source
ON target.transaction_id = source.transaction_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET *
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *
caption: One pass over today's incremental batch, not the whole Silver table.

code:
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

silver_table = DeltaTable.forName(spark, "silver.sales_clean")

(silver_table.alias("target")
    .merge(
        bronze_incremental_df.alias("source"),
        "target.transaction_id = source.transaction_id")
    .whenMatchedUpdateAll()
    .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
    .execute())
caption: The DeltaTable API: same logic, same match key.
